source.text: לְ֭כוּ נְרַנְּנָ֣ה לַיהוָ֑ה נָ֝רִ֗יעָה לְצ֣וּר יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Come, let us sing for joy to YHWH; let us shout aloud to [the] rock of our salvation.

en.L: Come, let us sing for joy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q let us shout aloud to the rock of our salvation.
en.B: Come, let us sing out with joy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q and raise a glad shout to the Rock who saves us.
en.R: Come and sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with joy! \q Shout happily to God, our Rock, who rescues us.

fr.L: Venez, chantons de joie {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ; \q poussons des cris vers le rocher de notre salut.
fr.B: Venez, chantons avec joie {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} \q et lançons des cris joyeux vers le Rocher qui nous sauve.
fr.R: Venez chanter avec joie {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! \q Criez de bonheur pour Dieu, notre Rocher, qui nous délivre.

sw.L: Njooni, tumwimbie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa furaha; \q tumpigie kelele mwamba wa wokovu wetu.
sw.B: Njooni, tumwimbie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa shangwe \q na kumpigia kelele za furaha Mwamba anayetuokoa.
sw.R: Njooni tumwimbie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa furaha! \q Tumshangilie Mungu, Mwamba wetu, anayetuokoa.

es.L: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, cantemos con júbilo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; \q aclamemos a la roca de nuestra salvación.
es.B: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, cantemos con alegría {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} \q y alcemos gritos de gozo a la Roca que nos salva.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} a cantar con alegría {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! \q {{plural_you:Griten|Gritad}} de felicidad a Dios, nuestra Roca, que nos rescata.

vi.L: Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy reo hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q chúng ta hãy lớn tiếng tung hô vầng đá của sự cứu rỗi chúng ta.
vi.B: Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy cất tiếng hát vui mừng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} \q và reo hò mừng rỡ với Vầng Đá, Đấng giải cứu chúng ta.
vi.R: Hãy đến hát mừng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Hãy reo hò vui vẻ cho Đức Chúa Trời, Vầng Đá của chúng ta, Đấng giải cứu chúng ta.

ko.L: 오너라, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기뻐 노래하자. \q 우리 구원의 반석께 크게 외치자.
ko.B: 오너라, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기쁨으로 노래하자. \q 우리를 구원하시는 반석께 즐거이 외치자.
ko.R: 모두 와서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기쁘게 노래하자! \q 우리를 구해 주시는 반석, 우리 하나님께 즐겁게 외치자.

pt.L: Venham, cantemos com alegria {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}; \q aclamemos a rocha da nossa salvação.
pt.B: Venham, vamos cantar de alegria {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} \q e erguer um grito alegre à Rocha que nos salva.
pt.R: Venham cantar com alegria {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}! \q Gritem de alegria para Deus, a nossa Rocha, que nos livra.

am.L: ኑ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በደስታ እንዘምር፤ \q ለመዳናችን ዓለት እልል እንበል።
am.B: ኑ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በደስታ እንዘምር፤ \q ለሚያድነን ዓለት በደስታ እልል እንበል።
am.R: ኑ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በደስታ ዘምሩ! \q ለሚያድነን ዓለታችን ለእግዚአብሔር በደስታ እልል በሉ።

hi.L: आओ, हम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए आनंद से गाएँ; \q अपने उद्धार की चट्टान के लिए ऊँचे स्वर से जयजयकार करें।
hi.B: आओ, हम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए आनंद से गाएँ \q और उनका जयजयकार करें जो हमारी चट्टान हैं और हमारा उद्धार करते हैं।
hi.R: आओ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए आनंद से गाओ! \q परमेश्वर का, जो हमारी चट्टान हैं और हमें छुड़ाते हैं, ख़ुशी से जयजयकार करो।

ru.L: Придите, споём радостно {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}; \q будем громко восклицать скале нашего спасения.
ru.B: Придите, воспоём с радостью {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} \q и поднимем радостный крик скале, что спасает нас.
ru.R: Придите и пойте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} с радостью! \q Радостно кричите Богу, нашей скале, который спасает нас.

ja.L: さあ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に喜び歌おう。 \q わたしたちの救いの岩に、喜びの叫びを上げよう。
ja.B: さあ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に向かって、喜びの声を上げて歌おう。 \q わたしたちを救う岩なる方に、喜び叫ぼう。
ja.R: さあ、来て、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に喜んで歌おう！ \q わたしたちの岩、わたしたちを救い出してくださる神に、喜びの声を上げよう！

uk.L: Ходіть, радісно заспіваймо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}; \q голосно викликуймо скелі нашого спасіння.
uk.B: Ходіть, радісно заспіваймо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} \q і здіймімо веселий клич Скелі, що спасає нас.
uk.R: Ходіть і співайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} з радістю! \q Радісно вигукуйте Богові, нашій Скелі, який рятує нас.

decisions.choice: a psalm with no title
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gives this psalm no title. The ancient Greek translation adds one naming David, and Hebrews 4:7 speaks of God saying its words "through David". Psalms 93-100 belong together as songs of the LORD as King.

decisions.choice: the rock of our salvation: God who saves us
decisions.reason: A rock is a high, safe place no enemy can reach (18:3; 62:3). "Of our salvation" describes the rock: God is the strong one who saves his people.

decisions.choice: the Rock who saves us (B); God, our Rock, who rescues us (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the phrase means (m2); Readable names God, since the rock stands for him.

decisions.choice: "Mwamba" with a capital at Balanced and Readable, where it names God
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable write "Rock" as a name for God here; Swahili does the same, while Literal keeps the plain picture.

decisions.choice: Vengan, with Venid as the alternative
decisions.reason: The call is to the gathered worshipers, so the plural command takes the plural you setting: the Latin American form by default, the form of Spain as the alternative. The same holds in the calls to praise that follow.

decisions.choice: "chúng ta" for "us" when the singer calls the worshipers together
decisions.reason: The singer counts himself among those he calls to worship, so Vietnamese uses the inclusive "chúng ta"; "chúng tôi" is kept for the people speaking to God.

decisions.choice: The call to worship (verses 1-7) is in 해라체 with the hortative "-자" (let us) and the command "오너라" (come)
decisions.reason: The singer calls the congregation to praise and speaks of God in the third person with the honorific; the plain written style of Korean poetry has the hortative "-자" for "let us". God's own words in verses 8-11 are also in 해라체.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; the Amharic text has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: "अपने उद्धार की चट्टान" (L); "जो हमारी चट्टान हैं और हमारा उद्धार करते हैं" (B), "जो हमारी चट्टान हैं और हमें छुड़ाते हैं" (R)
decisions.reason: The rock is God himself, who saves his people (meaning m2). The rock is "चट्टान", as the poetry note has it; Balanced and Readable say what the phrase means, with the honorific verb that shows the rock is God.

decisions.choice: "скала" with a small letter at every level
decisions.reason: The English capitalises "Rock" at Balanced and Readable, but Russian keeps "скала" for God lowercase, as 2 Samuel 22 and the rest of Psalms do; the context shows it is God.

decisions.choice: lekhu neranenah "さあ…喜び歌おう" (cohortative 〜しよう at every level)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is 'let us', so all three levels say 〜しよう, as the Psalter's R does for God's people. The rock of our salvation is God who saves us (m2).

source.text: נְקַדְּמָ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּתוֹדָ֑ה בִּ֝זְמִר֗וֹת נָרִ֥יעַֽ לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let us come to meet his face with thanksgiving; with songs let us shout aloud to him.

en.L: Let us come before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face with thanksgiving; \q with songs let us shout aloud to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Let us go out to meet {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with thanks, \q and lift a glad shout to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in our songs.
en.R: Let us come to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and thank {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Let us sing songs and cheer for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Allons au-devant de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face avec des actions de grâce ; \q par des chants, acclamons-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}.
fr.B: Allons à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} rencontre avec des remerciements, \q et acclamons-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} par nos chants.
fr.R: Approchons-nous de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et remercions-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}. \q Chantons des chants et acclamons-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}.

sw.L: Tuje mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kwa shukrani; \q kwa nyimbo tumpigie kelele za shangwe.
sw.B: Twende kumlaki kwa shukrani, \q tumpigie kelele za furaha katika nyimbo zetu.
sw.R: Tumjie na kumshukuru. \q Tuimbe nyimbo na kumshangilia.

es.L: Lleguemos ante {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro con acción de gracias; \q con cánticos aclamémoslo.
es.B: Salgamos a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} encuentro con gratitud, \q y alcemos para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} gritos de gozo con nuestros cantos.
es.R: Vamos a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y démosle gracias. \q Cantemos canciones y aclamémoslo.

vi.L: Chúng ta hãy đến trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với lời cảm tạ; \q với những bài ca, chúng ta hãy lớn tiếng tung hô {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Chúng ta hãy ra đón {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với lời cảm tạ, \q và cất tiếng reo mừng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bằng những bài ca.
vi.R: Chúng ta hãy đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Chúng ta hãy hát những bài ca và reo hò mừng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 감사함으로 그분 얼굴 앞에 나아가자. \q 노래로 그분께 크게 외치자.
ko.B: 감사하며 그분을 맞으러 나아가자. \q 노래하며 그분께 즐거이 외치자.
ko.R: 그분께 나아가 감사드리자. \q 노래를 부르며 그분께 환호하자.

pt.L: Cheguemos diante da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} face com ação de graças; \q com cânticos gritemos de alegria para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.
pt.B: Vamos ao encontro {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} com gratidão \q e, com os nossos cânticos, vamos erguer a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} um grito alegre.
pt.R: Vamos até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} e vamos agradecer a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. \q Vamos cantar canções e aclamá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}.

am.L: በምስጋና ወደ ፊቱ እንቅረብ፤ \q በመዝሙርም እልል እንበልለት።
am.B: በምስጋና ልንገናኘው እንውጣ፤ \q በዝማሬያችንም በደስታ እልል እንበልለት።
am.R: ወደ እርሱ እንምጣ፤ እናመስግነውም። \q መዝሙር እንዘምርለት፤ በደስታም እንጩኽለት።

hi.L: आओ, हम धन्यवाद करते हुए उनके सम्मुख आएँ; \q भजन गाते हुए उनका जयजयकार करें।
hi.B: आओ, हम धन्यवाद के साथ उनसे भेंट करने चलें \q और अपने गीतों में उनका आनंद से जयजयकार करें।
hi.R: आओ, उनके पास चलें और उनका धन्यवाद करें। \q आओ, गीत गाएँ और उनकी जय-जयकार करें।

ru.L: Предстанем пред {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} лицом с благодарением; \q в песнях будем восклицать {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}.
ru.B: Выйдем навстречу {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} с благодарностью \q и в наших песнях поднимем к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}} радостный клич.
ru.R: Придём к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}} и поблагодарим {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}. \q Будем петь песни и громко славить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.

ja.L: 感謝をもって、その方の顔の前に進み出よう。 \q ほめ歌をもって、その方に喜び叫ぼう。
ja.B: 感謝をささげつつ、その方を迎えに出よう。 \q 歌をもって、その方に喜びの声を上げよう。
ja.R: その方のもとに行って、感謝しよう。 \q 歌を歌って、その方に喜びの声を上げよう。

uk.L: Прийдімо перед {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} обличчя з подякою; \q з піснями голосно викликуймо {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}.
uk.B: Вийдімо {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} назустріч із подякою \q і здіймімо до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} радісний клич у наших піснях.
uk.R: Прийдімо до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} й подякуймо {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}. \q Співаймо пісні й радісно вітаймо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}.

decisions.choice: come to meet: come before, approach
decisions.reason: The verb (qiddem) is to come in front of someone, to meet him. With "his face" it means coming into God's presence, as people came to meet a king.

decisions.choice: thanksgiving: thanks spoken or sung
decisions.reason: The word (todah) is thanks, and also the offering brought to give thanks (Leviticus 7:12). Here it goes with songs, so spoken or sung thanks is meant first.

decisions.choice: songs: songs with music
decisions.reason: The word (zemirot) is used of songs sung to instruments.

decisions.choice: neqaddemah fanaw "その方の顔の前に進み出よう" (L), "その方を迎えに出よう" (B); bizmirot "ほめ歌をもって" (L), "歌をもって" (B)
decisions.reason: To come to meet is to come before, to approach (m1); the songs are songs with music (m3).

source.text: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ל גָּד֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וּמֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝ד֗וֹל עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For a great God [is] YHWH, and a great king above all gods,

en.L: For a great God [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and a great King above all gods,
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is a mighty God, \q a mighty King high over all gods,
en.R: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is a great God. \q He is the great King, far above anything people call a god.

fr.L: Car un grand Dieu, [c’est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et un grand Roi au-dessus de tous les dieux,
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est un Dieu puissant, \q un Roi puissant, bien au-dessus de tous les dieux,
fr.R: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est un grand Dieu. \q Il est le grand Roi, bien au-dessus de tout ce que les gens appellent un dieu.

sw.L: Kwa maana Mungu mkuu [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na Mfalme mkuu juu ya miungu yote,
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mungu mwenye nguvu, \q Mfalme mwenye nguvu aliye juu sana ya miungu yote,
sw.R: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mungu mkuu. \q Yeye ni Mfalme mkuu, aliye juu sana ya kila kitu ambacho watu hukiita mungu.

es.L: Porque Dios grande [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q y Rey grande sobre todos los dioses,
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es un Dios poderoso, \q un Rey poderoso, muy por encima de todos los dioses,
es.R: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es un Dios grande. \q Él es el gran Rey, muy por encima de todo lo que la gente llama dios.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời vĩ đại, \q và [là] Vua vĩ đại trên hết mọi thần,
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời quyền năng, \q là Vua quyền năng cao trổi hơn mọi thần,
vi.R: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời vĩ đại. \q Ngài là Vua vĩ đại, cao hơn hết mọi thứ người ta gọi là thần.

ko.L: 참으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위대하신 하나님이시요, \q 모든 신들 위에 계신 위대하신 왕이시다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 크신 하나님이시요, \q 모든 신들보다 높으신 크신 왕이시다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위대하신 하나님이시다. \q 그분은 사람들이 신이라고 부르는 어떤 것보다도 훨씬 높으신 위대한 왕이시다.

pt.L: Porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} [é] um grande Deus, \q e um grande Rei sobre todos os deuses,
pt.B: Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é um Deus poderoso, \q um Rei poderoso, muito acima de todos os deuses,
pt.R: Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é um grande Deus. \q Ele é o grande Rei, muito acima de qualquer coisa que as pessoas chamam de deus.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ አምላክ ነውና፤ \q ከአማልክትም ሁሉ በላይ ታላቅ ንጉሥ፣
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ኃያል አምላክ ነውና፤ \q ከአማልክት ሁሉ በላይ ከፍ ያለ ኃያል ንጉሥ ነው፤
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ አምላክ ነውና። \q ሰዎች አምላክ ብለው ከሚጠሩት ከማንኛውም ነገር እጅግ የሚበልጥ ታላቅ ንጉሥ ነው።

hi.L: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महान परमेश्वर [हैं], \q और सब देवताओं के ऊपर महान राजा,
hi.B: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} पराक्रमी परमेश्वर हैं, \q सब देवताओं से ऊँचे पराक्रमी राजा,
hi.R: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महान परमेश्वर हैं। \q वे महान राजा हैं, उन सब से कहीं ऊपर जिन्हें लोग देवता कहते हैं।

ru.L: Ведь великий Бог — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, \q и великий Царь превыше всех богов,
ru.B: Ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — могучий Бог, \q могучий Царь, высоко над всеми богами,
ru.R: Ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — великий Бог. \q Он — великий Царь, гораздо выше всего, что люди называют богами.

ja.L: まことに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は大いなる神、 \q すべての神々の上に立つ大いなる王[である]。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は力ある神、 \q すべての神々の上に高くおられる力ある王である。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は偉大な神。 \q 人々が神と呼ぶどんなものよりも、はるかに上におられる偉大な王だ。

uk.L: Бо великий Бог — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, \q і великий Цар над усіма богами,
uk.B: Бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — могутній Бог, \q могутній Цар, високо понад усіма богами,
uk.R: Бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — великий Бог. \q Він — великий Цар, набагато вищий за все, що люди називають богом.

decisions.choice: all gods: the gods the nations worshiped
decisions.reason: The psalm does not grant that these gods are real powers; Psalm 96:5 calls them worthless idols. It says that the LORD is King over everything that is called a god.

decisions.choice: King: the LORD as King of all
decisions.reason: Psalms 93 and 95-99 celebrate the LORD as King over his people, the nations and the whole of creation. "King" is a title of God here, so it is capitalized.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: Verses 4 and 5 begin with "who" and describe this King, so the sentence runs on and the verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: anything people call a god
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the other gods are not real rivals (m1).

decisions.choice: El gadol ("a great God") as "ታላቅ አምላክ"
decisions.reason: The noun stands as a predicate with an adjective ("a great God"), where Amharic says "አምላክ", as the style guide sets for a predicate; El alone is otherwise "እግዚአብሔር" in these psalms.

decisions.choice: "राजा" for God as King
decisions.reason: God is King in Psalms 93 and 95-99 (meaning m2). Hindi has no capital letters, so the title shows in the honorific plural and in the cry that recurs through these psalms, kept in one wording ("{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} राज्य करते हैं" at Literal, "... राजा हैं!" at Balanced and Readable; see 93:1). Readable says "जिन्हें लोग देवता कहते हैं", as in 1 Chronicles 16:25.

decisions.choice: The run-on sentence of 95:3-5 is closed in each verse and picked up with その方 in 95:4-5
decisions.reason: The Hebrew runs on with 'who…' (m3); Japanese closes each verse and restarts, as in the Psalter's other run-on verses. All gods are the gods the nations worshiped (m1), which R says as the English R.

source.text: אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭יָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְתוֹעֲפ֖וֹת הָרִ֣ים לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: who in his hand [are the] depths of [the] earth, and [the] peaks of [the] mountains [are] his,

en.L: in whose hand [are] the depths of the earth, \q and the peaks of the mountains [are] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}},
en.B: who holds the deep places of the earth in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand; \q the tops of the mountains are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} as well,
en.R: He holds the deepest places of the earth in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand. \q The highest mountains belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui tient en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main les profondeurs de la terre, \q et les sommets des montagnes [sont] à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}},
fr.B: {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui tient dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main les lieux profonds de la terre ; \q les sommets des montagnes sont à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} aussi,
fr.R: Il tient dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main les endroits les plus profonds de la terre. \q Les plus hautes montagnes {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartiennent.

sw.L: ambaye mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}} [zimo] sehemu za chini za nchi, \q na vilele vya milima [ni] {{deity_pronoun:vyake|Vyake}},
sw.B: ambaye anashika vilindi vya nchi mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}; \q vilele vya milima navyo ni {{deity_pronoun:vyake|Vyake}},
sw.R: Anashika mahali pa chini kabisa pa nchi mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}. \q Milima mirefu kuliko yote ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

es.L: en cuya mano [están] las profundidades de la tierra, \q y las cumbres de los montes [son] {{deity_pronoun:suyas|Suyas}},
es.B: que tiene en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano los lugares profundos de la tierra; \q también las cimas de los montes son {{deity_pronoun:suyas|Suyas}},
es.R: Él tiene en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano los lugares más profundos de la tierra. \q Los montes más altos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenecen.

vi.L: những nơi sâu thẳm của đất [ở] trong tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và những đỉnh núi [là] của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: Đấng cầm những nơi sâu thẳm của đất trong tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q các đỉnh núi cũng thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.R: Ngài nắm giữ những nơi sâu nhất của đất trong tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Những ngọn núi cao nhất thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 땅의 깊은 곳들이 그분의 손안에 [있고], \q 산들의 봉우리도 그분의 것이다.
ko.B: 그분께서 땅의 깊은 곳을 손에 쥐고 계시고, \q 산꼭대기들도 그분의 것이다.
ko.R: 그분께서 땅의 가장 깊은 곳을 손에 쥐고 계신다. \q 가장 높은 산들도 그분의 것이다.

pt.L: em cuja mão [estão] as profundezas da terra, \q e os cumes dos montes [são] {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}},
pt.B: que segura na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão os lugares profundos da terra; \q os picos dos montes também são {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}},
pt.R: Ele segura na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão os lugares mais fundos da terra. \q As montanhas mais altas pertencem a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.

am.L: የምድር ጥልቆች በእጁ ያሉ፣ \q የተራሮችም ከፍታዎች የእርሱ የሆኑ፣
am.B: የምድርን ጥልቅ ስፍራዎች በእጁ የያዘ ነው፤ \q የተራሮች ጫፎችም ደግሞ የእርሱ ናቸው፤
am.R: የምድርን እጅግ ጥልቅ ስፍራዎች በእጁ ይዟል። \q ረጃጅሞቹ ተራሮች የእርሱ ናቸው።

hi.L: जिनके हाथ में पृथ्वी के गहरे स्थान [हैं], \q और पहाड़ों की चोटियाँ भी उन्हीं की [हैं],
hi.B: जो पृथ्वी के गहरे स्थानों को अपने हाथ में थामे हुए हैं; \q पहाड़ों की चोटियाँ भी उन्हीं की हैं,
hi.R: वे पृथ्वी के सबसे गहरे स्थानों को अपने हाथ में थामे हुए हैं। \q सबसे ऊँचे पहाड़ भी उन्हीं के हैं।

ru.L: в чьей руке глубины земли, \q и вершины гор — {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}},
ru.B: который держит в своей руке глубины земли; \q вершины гор тоже принадлежат {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}},
ru.R: Он держит в своей руке самые глубокие места земли. \q Самые высокие горы принадлежат {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}.

ja.L: その方の手には地の深い所があり、 \q 山々の頂もその方のもの。
ja.B: 地の深い所も、その方の手の中にあり、 \q 山々の頂も、その方のものである。
ja.R: その方は、地のいちばん深い所を、手の中に持っておられる。 \q いちばん高い山々も、その方のものだ。

uk.L: у чиїй руці глибини землі, \q і вершини гір — {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}},
uk.B: який тримає в руці глибини землі; \q вершини гір — теж {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}},
uk.R: Він тримає в руці найглибші місця землі. \q Найвищі гори належать {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}.

decisions.choice: depths: places to be searched out
decisions.reason: The word (mechqar) occurs only here; it comes from the verb "search out", so it is the hidden depths no one can explore.

decisions.choice: peaks: the heights
decisions.reason: The word (to'afot) is rare; it is used of the horns of a wild ox (Numbers 23:22), and here of the highest points of the mountains.

decisions.choice: the depths and the heights
decisions.reason: The lowest and highest parts of the earth stand for all of it: there is nothing outside the King's rule.

decisions.choice: Verses 4 and 5 are sentences of their own about God, and verse 3 ends with a stop
alternatives: relative clauses on "왕" carried over from verse 3
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "who" (in whose hand) describes the King of verse 3. A Korean relative clause must come before its noun, which would move these verses into verse 3, so Korean states them as their own sentences, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: mechqerei-'arets "地の深い所" (L, B); to'afot harim "山々の頂" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Depths and peaks (m1, m2, uncertain) are the lowest and the highest places (m3).

source.text: אֲשֶׁר־ל֣וֹ הַ֭יָּם וְה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑הוּ וְ֝יַבֶּ֗שֶׁת יָדָ֥יו יָצָֽרוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: who [has] the sea, for he made it, and [the] dry land his hands formed.

en.L: whose [is] the sea, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made it, \q and the dry land {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands formed.
en.B: the sea belongs to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made it, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands shaped the dry ground.
en.R: He made the sea, so it belongs to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q With {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own hands {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shaped the dry land.

fr.L: à qui [est] la mer, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a faite, \q et la terre ferme, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} mains l’ont formée.
fr.B: la mer est à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, puisqu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a faite, \q et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} mains ont façonné la terre ferme.
fr.R: Il a fait la mer, alors elle est à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q De {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} propres mains, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a façonné la terre ferme.

sw.L: ambaye bahari [ni] {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliifanya, \q na nchi kavu mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} iliiumba.
sw.B: bahari ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliifanya, \q na mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} iliifinyanga nchi kavu.
sw.R: Yeye aliifanya bahari, kwa hiyo ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Kwa mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mwenyewe aliifinyanga nchi kavu.

es.L: de quien [es] el mar, pues {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo hizo, \q y la tierra seca formaron {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos.
es.B: el mar es {{deity_pronoun:suyo|Suyo}} porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo hizo, \q y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos formaron la tierra seca.
es.R: Él hizo el mar, así que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenece. \q Con {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} propias manos formó la tierra seca.

vi.L: biển [là] của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm ra nó, \q và đất khô, tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nắn nên.
vi.B: biển thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm ra nó, \q và tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nắn nên đất liền.
vi.R: Ngài đã làm ra biển, nên biển thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Chính tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nắn nên đất liền.

ko.L: 바다도 그분의 것이니, 그분께서 그것을 만드셨고, \q 마른 땅도 그분의 손이 빚으셨다.
ko.B: 바다가 그분의 것이니, 그분께서 그것을 만드셨기 때문이다. \q 마른 땅도 그분의 손이 빚으셨다.
ko.R: 그분께서 바다를 만드셨으니 바다는 그분의 것이다. \q 그분께서 친히 손으로 마른 땅을 빚으셨다.

pt.L: de quem [é] o mar, pois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o fez, \q e a terra seca as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} mãos formaram.
pt.B: o mar pertence a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o fez, \q e as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} mãos modelaram a terra seca.
pt.R: Ele fez o mar, e por isso o mar pertence a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. \q Com as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} próprias mãos {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} modelou a terra seca.

am.L: ባሕር የእርሱ የሆነ፣ እርሱ ሠርቶታልና፤ \q የብሱንም እጆቹ ሠሩት።
am.B: ባሕር የእርሱ ነው፤ እርሱ ሠርቶታልና፤ \q እጆቹም የብሱን ቀረጹ።
am.R: ባሕርን የሠራ እርሱ ነው፤ ስለዚህ የእርሱ ነው። \q በገዛ እጆቹ የብሱን ቀረጸ።

hi.L: जिनका समुद्र [है], क्योंकि उन्होंने उसे बनाया, \q और सूखी भूमि को उनके हाथों ने रचा।
hi.B: समुद्र उनका है, क्योंकि उन्होंने उसे बनाया, \q और उनके हाथों ने सूखी भूमि को गढ़ा।
hi.R: उन्होंने समुद्र बनाया, इसलिए वह उनका है। \q अपने ही हाथों से उन्होंने सूखी भूमि को गढ़ा।

ru.L: чьё — море, ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} создал его, \q и сушу образовали {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} руки.
ru.B: море принадлежит {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}, потому что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} создал его, \q и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} руки сформировали сушу.
ru.R: Он создал море, поэтому оно принадлежит {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}. \q Своими руками {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} создал сушу.

ja.L: 海はその方のもの、その方がそれを造られた。 \q 乾いた地も、その方の手が形づくった。
ja.B: 海はその方のもの。その方が造られたからだ。 \q 陸地も、その方の手が形づくったもの。
ja.R: その方が海を造られたので、海はその方のものだ。 \q その方は、ご自分の手で陸地を形づくられた。

uk.L: чиє море, бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} створив його, \q і суходіл утворили {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} руки.
uk.B: море належить {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}, бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} його створив, \q і {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} руки виліпили суходіл.
uk.R: Він створив море, тож воно належить {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}. \q Власними руками {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} виліпив суходіл.

decisions.choice: the sea and the dry land: the creation
decisions.reason: The pair recalls Genesis 1:9-10, where God gathers the waters and the dry land (yabbashah) appears. The King of the psalm owns the world because he made it.

decisions.choice: formed: shaped like a potter
decisions.reason: The verb (yatsar) is the potter's word, used of God forming the man from the dust (Genesis 2:7).

decisions.choice: yabbeshet "乾いた地" (L), "陸地" (B, R); yatsaru "形づくった" (L, B), "形づくられた" (R)
decisions.reason: The sea and the dry land recall the creation (m1); formed is shaped like a potter (m2). With the hands as subject the verb stays plain (L, B).

source.text: בֹּ֭אוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֣ה וְנִכְרָ֑עָה נִ֝בְרְכָ֗ה לִֽפְנֵי־יְהוָ֥ה עֹשֵֽׂנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Come, let us bow down and bend low; let us kneel before YHWH our maker.

en.L: Come, let us bow down and bend low; \q let us kneel before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our Maker.
en.B: Come, let us bow down to the ground and bend low; \q let us kneel in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the one who made us.
en.R: Come, let us bow low to the ground. \q Let us get down on our knees in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who made us.

fr.L: Venez, prosternons-nous et inclinons-nous ; \q fléchissons le genou devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui nous a faits.
fr.B: Venez, prosternons-nous jusqu’à terre et inclinons-nous ; \q mettons-nous à genoux devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, celui qui nous a faits.
fr.R: Venez, inclinons-nous jusqu’au sol. \q Mettons-nous à genoux devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui nous a faits.

sw.L: Njooni, tusujudu na kuinama; \q tupige magoti mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Muumba wetu.
sw.B: Njooni, tusujudu mpaka chini na kuinama; \q tupige magoti mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliyetuumba.
sw.R: Njooni, tuiname mpaka chini. \q Tupige magoti mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliyetuumba.

es.L: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, postrémonos e inclinémonos; \q arrodillémonos ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Hacedor.
es.B: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, postrémonos hasta el suelo e inclinémonos; \q arrodillémonos delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el que nos hizo.
es.R: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, inclinémonos hasta el suelo. \q Pongámonos de rodillas delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que nos hizo.

vi.L: Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy cúi lạy và khom mình; \q chúng ta hãy quỳ gối trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng Tạo Hóa của chúng ta.
vi.B: Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy sấp mình xuống đất và cúi rạp; \q chúng ta hãy quỳ trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đã dựng nên chúng ta.
vi.R: Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy cúi rạp xuống đất. \q Chúng ta hãy quỳ gối trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đã dựng nên chúng ta.

ko.L: 오너라, 엎드려 절하고 몸을 굽히자. \q 우리를 지으신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 무릎을 꿇자.
ko.B: 오너라, 땅에 엎드려 절하며 몸을 굽히자. \q 우리를 지으신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 무릎을 꿇자.
ko.R: 모두 와서 땅에 엎드려 절하자. \q 우리를 만드신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 무릎을 꿇자.

pt.L: Entrem, curvemo-nos até o chão e dobremo-nos; \q ponhamo-nos de joelhos diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o nosso Criador.
pt.B: Venham, vamos nos curvar até o chão e nos inclinar; \q vamos nos ajoelhar diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, aquele que nos fez.
pt.R: Venham, vamos nos curvar até o chão. \q Vamos ficar de joelhos diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que nos fez.

am.L: ኑ፣ እንስገድ፤ እንደፋም፤ \q በፈጣሪያችን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት እንንበርከክ።
am.B: ኑ፣ እስከ ምድር ዝቅ ብለን እንስገድ፤ እንደፋም፤ \q በሠራን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት እንንበርከክ።
am.R: ኑ፣ እስከ መሬት ዝቅ ብለን እንስገድ። \q በሠራን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት በጉልበታችን እንንበርከክ።

hi.L: आओ, हम दंडवत करें और झुकें; \q अपने कर्ता {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने घुटने टेकें।
hi.B: आओ, हम भूमि तक झुककर दंडवत करें; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने, जिन्होंने हमें बनाया, घुटने टेकें।
hi.R: आओ, हम भूमि तक झुकें। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने, जिन्होंने हमें बनाया, घुटनों के बल बैठें।

ru.L: Придите, падём ниц и склонимся; \q встанем на колени перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, нашим Создателем.
ru.B: Придите, поклонимся до земли и склонимся; \q преклоним колени перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, который создал нас.
ru.R: Придите, низко поклонимся до земли. \q Встанем на колени перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, который создал нас.

ja.L: さあ、ひれ伏し、身をかがめよう。 \q わたしたちの造り主、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前にひざまずこう。
ja.B: さあ、地にひれ伏し、身をかがめよう。 \q わたしたちを造られた方、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前にひざまずこう。
ja.R: さあ、地面に顔をつけるほど、深く身をかがめよう。 \q わたしたちを造ってくださった{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前に、ひざまずこう。

uk.L: Ходіть, поклонімося й схилімося; \q станьмо на коліна перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, нашим Творцем.
uk.B: Ходіть, поклонімося до землі й схилімося низько; \q станьмо на коліна перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, тим, хто створив нас.
uk.R: Ходіть, поклонімося до самої землі. \q Станьмо на коліна перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, який нас створив.

decisions.choice: come: come in
decisions.reason: The command (bo'u) is to come or go in. After the call to come before God in verse 2, it invites the worshipers into the temple courts.

decisions.choice: bow down, bend low, kneel: worship with the whole body
decisions.reason: The first verb (hishtachavah) is to bow to the ground, the usual act of worship; the second (kara') is to bend the knees; the third (barak) is to kneel, the same root as "bless". The three verbs together picture a full bow before the King.

decisions.choice: our Maker: the one who made us his people
decisions.reason: After verses 4-5 the word recalls creation, but "our" points to Israel too: the LORD made them his people (Deuteronomy 32:6, 15), as verse 7 goes on to say.

decisions.choice: nishtachaweh / nikhra'ah / nivrekhah "ひれ伏し" / "身をかがめよう" / "ひざまずこう"; barakh here 'kneel', not ほめたたえる
decisions.reason: Three verbs of worship with the whole body (m2); nivrekhah is the verb for kneeling, so it is not the Psalter's ほめたたえる. Our Maker is the one who made us his people (m3).

source.text: כִּ֘י ה֤וּא אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַ֣ם מַ֭רְעִיתוֹ וְצֹ֣אן יָד֑וֹ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אִֽם־בְּקֹל֥וֹ תִשְׁמָֽעוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For he [is] our God, and we [are the] people of his pasture and [the] flock of his hand. Today, if to his voice you will listen!

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] our God, \q and we [are] the people of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} pasture and the flock of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand. \q Today, if you will listen to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice!
en.B: For it is {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} who is our God, \q and we are a people {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} pastures, a flock {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} tends with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own hand. \q Oh, that today you would listen to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice!
en.R: He is our God. \q We are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, like sheep that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} feeds and leads. \q If only you would listen to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice today!

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [est] notre Dieu, \q et nous [sommes] le peuple de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} pâturage et le troupeau de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main. \q Aujourd’hui, si vous écoutiez {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix !
fr.B: Car c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui est notre Dieu, \q et nous sommes un peuple qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait paître, un troupeau qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} conduit de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre main. \q Ah, si aujourd’hui vous écoutiez {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix !
fr.R: Il est notre Dieu. \q Nous sommes {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, comme des brebis qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nourrit et conduit. \q Si seulement vous écoutiez {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix aujourd’hui !

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ni] Mungu wetu, \q nasi [ni] watu wa malisho {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na kondoo wa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Leo, kama mtaisikiliza sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}!
sw.B: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye Mungu wetu, \q nasi ni watu anaowalisha, kundi analolichunga kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe. \q Laiti leo mngeisikiliza sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}!
sw.R: Yeye ni Mungu wetu. \q Sisi ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, kama kondoo anaowalisha na kuwaongoza. \q Laiti mngeisikiliza sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} leo!

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] nuestro Dios, \q y nosotros [somos] el pueblo de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} prado y el rebaño de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano. \q ¡Hoy, si {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz!
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es nuestro Dios, \q y somos un pueblo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} apacienta, un rebaño que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} cuida con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia mano. \q ¡Ojalá hoy {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchéis}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz!
es.R: Él es nuestro Dios. \q Somos {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, como ovejas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} alimenta y guía. \q ¡Si tan solo {{plural_you:escucharan|escuchaseis}} hoy {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz!

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta, \q và chúng ta [là] dân của đồng cỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và bầy chiên của tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Hôm nay, nếu mọi người chịu lắng nghe tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.B: Vì chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta, \q và chúng ta là dân được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chăn nuôi, là bầy chiên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tự tay chăm sóc. \q Ôi, ước gì hôm nay mọi người lắng nghe tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.R: Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta. \q Chúng ta là dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, như bầy chiên được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho ăn và dẫn dắt. \q Ước gì hôm nay mọi người chịu nghe tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

ko.L: 참으로 그분은 우리의 하나님이시요, \q 우리는 그분 목장의 백성, 그분 손의 양 떼이다. \q 오늘, 너희가 그분의 음성을 듣는다면!
ko.B: 그분은 바로 우리의 하나님이시고, \q 우리는 그분이 먹이시는 백성, 그분이 손수 돌보시는 양 떼이다. \q 아, 오늘 너희가 그분의 음성을 듣기만 한다면!
ko.R: 그분은 우리의 하나님이시다. \q 우리는 그분의 백성이다. 그분께서 먹이시고 이끄시는 양 떼와 같다. \q 오늘 너희가 그분의 음성을 듣는다면 얼마나 좋겠느냐!

pt.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [é] o nosso Deus, \q e nós [somos] o povo do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} pasto e o rebanho da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão. \q Hoje, se vocês ouvirem a voz {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}!
pt.B: Pois é {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o nosso Deus, \q e nós somos um povo que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} apascenta, um rebanho que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} conduz com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} própria mão. \q Quem dera hoje vocês ouvissem a voz {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}!
pt.R: Ele é o nosso Deus. \q Nós somos o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, como ovelhas que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} alimenta e conduz. \q Se ao menos vocês ouvissem a voz {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} hoje!

am.L: እርሱ አምላካችን ነውና፤ \q እኛም የማሰማሪያው ሕዝብ፣ የእጁም በጎች [ነን]። \q ዛሬ ድምፁን ብትሰሙ!
am.B: አምላካችን እርሱ ነውና፤ \q እኛም እርሱ የሚያሰማራን ሕዝብ፣ በገዛ እጁ የሚጠብቀን መንጋ ነን። \q ዛሬ ድምፁን ብትሰሙ እንዴት መልካም ነበር!
am.R: እርሱ አምላካችን ነው። \q እኛም ሕዝቡ ነን፤ እርሱ እንደሚመግባቸውና እንደሚመራቸው በጎች ነን። \q ዛሬ ድምፁን ብትሰሙ ምንኛ መልካም ነበር!

hi.L: क्योंकि वे हमारे परमेश्वर [हैं], \q और हम उनकी चराई की प्रजा और उनके हाथ की भेड़ें [हैं]। \q आज, यदि तुम उनकी आवाज़ सुनो!
hi.B: क्योंकि वही हमारे परमेश्वर हैं, \q और हम वह प्रजा हैं जिसे वे चराते हैं, वह झुंड जिसकी वे अपने हाथ से देखभाल करते हैं। \q काश, आज तुम उनकी आवाज़ सुनो!
hi.R: वे हमारे परमेश्वर हैं। \q हम उनकी प्रजा हैं, उन भेड़ों के समान जिन्हें वे चराते और ले चलते हैं। \q काश, आज तुम उनकी आवाज़ सुनो!

ru.L: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} — наш Бог, \q а мы — народ {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} пастбища и стадо {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} руки. \q Сегодня, если вы услышите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} голос!
ru.B: Ведь именно {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} — наш Бог, \q а мы — народ, который {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} пасёт, стадо, о котором {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} заботится своей рукой. \q О, если бы сегодня вы послушались {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} голоса!
ru.R: Он — наш Бог. \q Мы — {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} народ, как овцы, которых {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} кормит и ведёт. \q Если бы только вы сегодня послушались {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} голоса!

ja.L: まことに、その方はわたしたちの神、 \q わたしたちはその方の牧場の民、その方の手の羊。 \q 今日、あなたがたがその方の声に聞き従うなら！
ja.B: その方こそ、わたしたちの神。 \q わたしたちは、その方が養われる民、その方がご自分の手で世話をされる群れ。 \q ああ、今日、あなたがたがその方の声に聞き従ってくれたなら！
ja.R: その方は、わたしたちの神。 \q わたしたちはその方の民。その方が養い、導いてくださる羊のようだ。 \q 今日、あなたたちがその方の声を聞いてくれたら、どんなによいだろう！

uk.L: Бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} — наш Бог, \q а ми — народ {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} пасовиська й отара {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} руки. \q Сьогодні, якби ви послухали {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} голосу!
uk.B: Бо саме {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} — наш Бог, \q а ми — народ, який {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} пасе, отара, яку {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} доглядає власною рукою. \q О, якби ви сьогодні послухали {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} голосу!
uk.R: Він — наш Бог. \q Ми — {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} народ, як вівці, яких {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} годує й провадить. \q Якби ж ви сьогодні послухали {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} голосу!

decisions.choice: the people of his pasture, the flock of his hand: the people he feeds and leads
decisions.reason: God is pictured as the shepherd of Israel (23:1; 80:2). "His hand" is the hand that guides and cares for the flock.

decisions.choice: Today, if you would listen: a wish, "if only"
alternatives: Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts (joined to verse 8)
decisions.reason: The words "if" and "you will listen" without a following "then" make a wish: the speaker longs for the people to listen. They may also be read as the start of verse 8, "Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts", as Hebrews 3:7-8 quotes them.
Hebrews quotes verses 7-11 from the ancient Greek translation as the voice of the Holy Spirit, and builds on the word "today": the offer of God's rest still stands for those who listen (Hebrews 4:7).

decisions.choice: like sheep that he feeds and leads
alternatives: the people of his pasture and the flock of his hand
decisions.reason: Readable makes the picture a comparison and says what the shepherd does (m1).

decisions.choice: "mọi người" for "you" when the singer turns to the people
decisions.reason: The singer now speaks to the gathered worshipers. "mọi người" (everyone) is a warm, neutral way to address a crowd of men and women; "anh em" names only brothers, and "các người" would be a rebuke.

decisions.choice: the wording of Hebrews 3:7-11 and 4:3-7 where the Hebrew allows
decisions.reason: Hebrews quotes verses 7-11 (m3), so each level takes the Portuguese of Hebrews at the same level wherever the Hebrew says the same: "Hoje, se vocês ouvirem a voz dele" (L), with "a voz dele" and "vocês" as there; "não endureçam o coração" (L, B), "não deixem o coração de vocês ficar duro" (R); "puseram à prova", "o coração deles vive se desviando", "nunca chegaram a conhecer os meus caminhos" (B); "jurei na minha ira" and "descanso" at every level. Where the Hebrew differs from the Greek Hebrews quotes, the Hebrew is followed: the wish of verse 7 at Balanced and Readable ("Quem dera", "Se ao menos"), the names Meribá and Massá for "rebellion" and "testing", and "senti aversão" for "fiquei irado" in verse 10.

decisions.choice: "ዛሬ ድምፁን ብትሰሙ" (today, if you hear his voice), the wording of Hebrews 3:7, 15; 4:7 in the Amharic New Testament; Balanced and Readable add the wish ("እንዴት መልካም ነበር!") as the English
decisions.reason: Hebrews quotes verses 7-11 three times; where the Hebrew agrees with the Greek the Amharic keeps the New Testament's words. The Hebrew line can be a wish (the meaning decision), which Balanced and Readable make plain.

decisions.choice: "आज, यदि तुम उनकी आवाज़ सुनो" (L); "काश, आज तुम उनकी आवाज़ सुनो!" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Hebrews 3:7, 3:15 and 4:7 quote these words in Hindi as "आज, यदि तुम उनकी आवाज़ सुनो" at every level. Literal keeps that wording exactly. In the Hebrew the words are a wish, "if only" (meaning m2), and Balanced and Readable say so with "काश", as the English does; the words themselves stay those of Hebrews.

decisions.choice: "Сегодня, если вы услышите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} голос" (L); a wish at B and R
alternatives: Сегодня, если вы услышите его голос (B, R)
decisions.reason: Hebrews 3:7 and 4:7 quote this line; Literal keeps the wording of this translation's Hebrews. The Hebrew is a wish ("if only", m2), so Balanced and Readable say it as one ("О, если бы...", "Если бы только..."), as the English does.

decisions.choice: hayyom 'im-beqolo tishma'u "今日、あなたがたがその方の声に聞き従うなら！" (L), "ああ…聞き従ってくれたなら！" (B), "…どんなによいだろう！" (R); "その方の声" for HEB 3:7's 彼の声
decisions.reason: The line is a wish, 'if only' (m2, uncertain, footnote), not the protasis of 95:8; L keeps the bare 'if' with ！, B and R spell out the wish. Hebrews 3:7 quotes it (m3); its 今日 and 聞く are kept, but the Psalter never uses 彼 for God, so その方の声.

decisions.choice: 'am mar'ito vetso'n yado "その方の牧場の民、その方の手の羊" (L), "その方が養われる民…群れ" (B), "その方が養い、導いてくださる羊" (R)
decisions.reason: The people of his pasture and the flock of his hand are the people he feeds and leads (m1).

records.literal_gloss: Do not harden your heart as [at] Meribah, as [on the] day of Massah in the wilderness,

en.L: "Do not harden your heart as [at] Meribah, \q as [on] the day of Massah in the wilderness,
en.B: "Do not let your hearts grow hard, as happened at Meribah, \q on the day of Massah out in the desert,
en.R: "Do not be stubborn like your ancestors were at Meribah, the place of quarreling. \q Remember that day at Massah, the place of testing, in the desert.

fr.L: « N’endurcissez pas votre cœur comme [à] Meriba, \q comme [au] jour de Massa dans le désert,
fr.B: « Ne laissez pas votre cœur s’endurcir, comme à Meriba, \q comme au jour de Massa, là-bas dans le désert,
fr.R: « Ne soyez pas têtus comme vos ancêtres à Meriba, le lieu de la dispute. \q Rappelez-vous ce jour-là à Massa, le lieu de l’épreuve, dans le désert.

sw.L: "Msifanye mioyo yenu kuwa migumu kama [huko] Meriba, \q kama siku ya Masa nyikani,
sw.B: "Msiiache mioyo yenu iwe migumu, kama ilivyotokea huko Meriba, \q siku ile ya Masa kule jangwani,
sw.R: "Msiwe wakaidi kama babu zenu walivyokuwa huko Meriba, mahali pa ugomvi. \q Kumbukeni siku ile huko Masa, mahali pa kujaribu, kule jangwani.

es.L: «No {{plural_you:endurezcan su|endurezcáis vuestro}} corazón como [en] Meribá, \q como [en] el día de Masá en el desierto,
es.B: «No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}} se endurezca, como sucedió en Meribá, \q el día de Masá allá en el desierto,
es.R: «No {{plural_you:sean tercos como lo fueron sus|seáis tercos como lo fueron vuestros}} antepasados en Meribá, el lugar de la pelea. \q {{plural_you:Recuerden|Recordad}} aquel día en Masá, el lugar de la prueba, en el desierto.

vi.L: "Đừng làm cứng lòng các con như [tại] Mê-ri-ba, \q như [vào] ngày ở Ma-sa trong hoang mạc,
vi.B: "Đừng để lòng các con trở nên cứng cỏi như đã xảy ra tại Mê-ri-ba, \q vào ngày ở Ma-sa trong hoang mạc,
vi.R: "Đừng cứng đầu như tổ tiên các con tại Mê-ri-ba, nơi họ đã cãi lẽ. \q Hãy nhớ lại ngày ấy tại Ma-sa, nơi họ đã thử thách {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, trong hoang mạc.

ko.L: "너희 마음을 완고하게 하지 말아라, 므리바에서처럼, \q 광야의 맛사의 날처럼.
ko.B: "므리바에서 그랬던 것처럼, \q 광야의 맛사에서 그날 그랬던 것처럼 너희 마음을 완고하게 하지 말아라.
ko.R: "너희 조상들이 다툼의 곳 므리바에서 그랬던 것처럼 마음을 굳게 닫지 말아라. \q 광야에 있는 시험의 곳 맛사에서 있었던 그날을 기억하여라.

pt.L: "Não endureçam o coração de vocês como [em] Meribá, \q como [no] dia de Massá no deserto,
pt.B: "Não endureçam o coração, como aconteceu em Meribá, \q naquele dia em Massá, lá no deserto,
pt.R: "Não deixem o coração de vocês ficar duro, como os antepassados de vocês fizeram em Meribá, o lugar da discussão. \q Lembrem-se daquele dia em Massá, o lugar da prova, no deserto.

am.L: «በመሪባ እንደ ሆነው ልባችሁን አታደንድኑ፤ \q በምድረ በዳ በማሳ ቀን እንደ ሆነው፣
am.B: «በመሪባ እንደ ሆነው ልባችሁን አታደንድኑ፤ \q በምድረ በዳ በማሳ በዚያ ቀን እንደ ሆነው፣
am.R: «መሪባ በተባለው የጭቅጭቅ ስፍራ ቅድመ አያቶቻችሁ እንዳደረጉት ልባችሁን አታደንድኑ። \q ማሳ በተባለው የመፈተን ስፍራ በምድረ በዳ የሆነውን ያን ቀን አስታውሱ።

hi.L: "अपना मन कठोर न करो जैसे मरीबा [में], \q जैसे निर्जन प्रदेश में मस्सा के दिन,
hi.B: "अपने मन कठोर न होने दो, जैसा मरीबा में हुआ था, \q निर्जन प्रदेश में मस्सा के उस दिन,
hi.R: "वैसे हठी न बनो जैसे तुम्हारे पूर्वज मरीबा में, झगड़े की उस जगह में, बने थे। \q मस्सा का वह दिन याद करो, परीक्षा की वह जगह, सुनसान इलाक़े में।

ru.L: «Не ожесточайте ваших сердец, как в Мериве, \q как в день Массы в пустыне,
ru.B: «Не дайте вашим сердцам ожесточиться, как это было в Мериве, \q в тот день в Массе, в пустыне,
ru.R: «Не упрямьтесь, как ваши предки в Мериве, на месте спора. \q Вспомните тот день в Массе, на месте испытания, в пустыне.

ja.L: 「メリバでのように、 \q 荒れ野でのマサの日のように、あなたがたの心をかたくなにしてはならない。
ja.B: 「メリバで起きたように、 \q 荒れ野でのマサの日のように、心をかたくなにしてはならない。
ja.R: 「あなたたちの先祖は、言い争いの場所メリバで、かたくなになった。あなたたちは、そうなってはいけない。 \q 荒れ野のマサ、試みの場所での、あの日のことを思い出しなさい。

uk.L: «Не робіть твердим ваше серце, як [у] Меріві, \q як [у] день Масси в пустелі,
uk.B: «Не дайте вашим серцям затвердіти, як сталося в Меріві, \q того дня в Массі, у пустелі,
uk.R: «Не будьте вперті, як ваші предки в Меріві, місці сварки. \q Згадайте той день у Массі, місці випробування, у пустелі.

decisions.choice: God speaks from here to verse 11
decisions.reason: In verse 9 the speaker says "they tested me" and in verse 11 "my rest", so from here God himself speaks, warning his people. The words are put in quotation marks from here to the end of the psalm.

decisions.choice: Meribah and Massah: Exodus 17:1-7
decisions.reason: At Rephidim the people quarreled with Moses for water and tested the LORD, saying "Is the LORD among us or not?" (Exodus 17:7). The place was named Massah ("testing") and Meribah ("quarreling"). Numbers 20:1-13 tells of another Meribah.

decisions.choice: harden your heart: refuse to trust and obey
decisions.reason: The heart is the mind and will. To harden it is to become stubborn against God, as Pharaoh did (Exodus 9:34).

decisions.choice: your ancestors; the place of quarreling; the place of testing; Remember
decisions.reason: Readable names who was stubborn (from verse 9) and says what the two place names mean (m2).

decisions.choice: God speaks in the first person ("mimi") from here to verse 11; the people are addressed in the plural ("msifanye", "mioyo yenu")
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "your heart" is singular, but it is said to the whole people; Swahili uses its plural "you", which it has ready, so the reader hears that the warning is to everyone.

decisions.choice: "các con" for "you" when God speaks to his people in verses 8-11
decisions.reason: God speaks from here to verse 11 (see the meaning decision). He warns his own people as a father warns his children; "các con" says that, where "các ngươi" is archaic and "các người" would treat them as strangers.

decisions.choice: "nơi họ đã cãi lẽ", "nơi họ đã thử thách Ta" after the names
decisions.reason: The names mean "quarreling" and "testing" (see the meaning decision); Readable gives their sense, as the English Readable does, and says who was tested, as verse 9 does.

decisions.choice: "마음을 완고하게 하다" (L, B), "마음을 굳게 닫다" (R); "므리바", "맛사"
decisions.reason: As the Korean Hebrews 3:8, which quotes this verse: to harden the heart is to refuse to trust and obey (meaning decision m3). The places keep their Protestant names; Readable explains them, as the English Readable does. God speaks from here to verse 11 (meaning decision m1) in 해라체.

decisions.choice: Meribá, Massá; "o lugar da discussão", "o lugar da prova" (R)
decisions.reason: The names as the Portuguese of Exodus 17:7 writes them, and at Readable with the meanings Exodus 17:7 gives them at Readable ("discussão", "prova"), so the reader can find the story (m2).

decisions.choice: "ልባችሁን አታደንድኑ" (do not harden your hearts), as Hebrews 3:8; the places named "መሪባ" and "ማሳ", as Exodus 17:7 on main, where Hebrews has "the rebellion" and "the testing"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the places of Exodus 17:1-7, which the Greek translates as common nouns; the Amharic follows the Hebrew and keeps the names of Exodus 17:7, Readable adding their sense ("ጭቅጭቅ", "መፈተን") as Exodus 17:7 does.

decisions.choice: "मन कठोर न करो"; "मरीबा", "मस्सा"
decisions.reason: Hebrews 3:8 quotes this verse from the Greek, which translates the place names as "the rebellion" and "the testing". The Hebrew names the places (meaning m2), so the psalm keeps the names as Exodus 17:7 has them in this translation ("मस्सा", "मरीबा"), and Readable explains them as Exodus does. The words Hebrews shares are kept in its form: "मन कठोर न करो", the wilderness "निर्जन प्रदेश" (L, B) and "सुनसान इलाक़ा" (R). God speaks from here to the end (meaning m1).

decisions.choice: "Мерива", "Масса" as place names
alternatives: во время возмущения, в день испытания
decisions.reason: Hebrews 3:8 follows the Greek, which translates the two names ("возмущение", "испытание"); the Hebrew names the places of Exodus 17:7 (m2), so the psalm keeps the names in the forms of this translation's Exodus, while "Не ожесточайте ваших сердец" keeps Hebrews' wording.

decisions.choice: God's speech opens here (「, closed at 95:11); Meribah "メリバ", Massah "マサ" (EXO 17); "心をかたくなにしてはならない" as HEB 3:8
decisions.reason: God speaks from here to 95:11 (m1), in the plain style to あなたがた (R あなたたち). Meribah and Massah are the places of Exodus 17:1-7 (m2), with the Pentateuch's forms; R explains the names as the English R does. Hardening the heart is refusing to trust and obey (m3); Hebrews 3:8's Japanese is kept where the Hebrew agrees.

vi.L: khi tổ phụ các con thử {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q họ thử thách {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, dù họ đã thấy công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그때 너희 조상들이 나를 시험하였고, \q 내가 한 일을 보았으면서도 나를 떠보았다.

pt.R: Ali os antepassados de vocês {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} puseram à prova \q e continuaram {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} testando, embora tivessem visto tudo o que eu tinha feito.

am.L: አባቶቻችሁ በፈተኑኝ ጊዜ፤ \q ሥራዬን አይተው ሳሉ መረመሩኝ።
am.B: ቅድመ አያቶቻችሁ በፈተኑኝ ጊዜ፣ \q ሥራዬን ካዩ በኋላ እንኳ በተገዳደሩኝ ጊዜ።
am.R: በዚያ ቅድመ አያቶቻችሁ ፈተኑኝ፤ \q ያደረግኩትን ሁሉ አይተው ሳሉ ደጋግመው ፈተኑኝ።

hi.L: जब तुम्हारे बापदादों ने मुझे परखा; \q उन्होंने मेरी जाँच की, यद्यपि उन्होंने मेरे काम देखे थे।
hi.B: जब तुम्हारे पूर्वजों ने मुझे परखा \q और मेरी जाँच की, यद्यपि उन्होंने मेरे काम देखे थे।
hi.R: वहाँ तुम्हारे पूर्वजों ने मेरी परीक्षा ली \q और मुझे परखते रहे, यद्यपि उन्होंने वह सब देखा था जो मैंने किया था।

ru.L: когда испытывали {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} ваши отцы; \q проверяли {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, хотя видели {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} дело.
ru.B: когда ваши предки испытывали {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} \q и бросали {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} вызов, хотя видели {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} дела.
ru.R: Там ваши предки испытывали {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} \q и снова и снова проверяли {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, хотя видели всё, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сделал.

ja.L: その時、あなたがたの父祖たちはわたしを試み、 \q わたしを吟味した。わたしのわざを見ていたのに。
ja.B: あの時、あなたがたの先祖はわたしを試み、 \q わたしのわざを見ていながら、わたしを試した。
ja.R: そこで、あなたたちの先祖はわたしを試し、 \q わたしのしたことをすべて見ていたのに、わたしを試し続けた。

uk.L: коли ваші батьки випробовували {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}; \q вони спокушали {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, хоч бачили {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} діло.
uk.B: коли ваші предки випробовували {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} \q і кидали {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}} виклик, хоч і бачили {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} діло.
uk.R: Там ваші предки випробовували {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} \q і знову й знову перевіряли {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, хоч бачили все, що я зробив.

decisions.choice: tested, tried: demanded that God prove himself
decisions.reason: The two verbs (nasah, bachan) both mean to put to the test. Here it is people testing God, demanding signs instead of trusting him (Exodus 17:2; Numbers 14:22).

decisions.choice: my work: what God had done for them
decisions.reason: The work is God's rescue from Egypt and his care in the desert, which they had seen with their own eyes (Numbers 14:22).

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: The word ('avot) means the earlier generations of the people, women and men; Balanced and Readable say "ancestors".

Hebrews 3:9 has these words in Hindi as "तुम्हारे बापदादों ने ... परखा" (L) and "तुम्हारे पूर्वजों ने मुझे परखा और मेरी जाँच की" (B), and the psalm keeps them. "Ancestors" has no gender span in Hindi at Balanced and Readable: "पूर्वज" already means the earlier generations, women and men. Hebrews, following the Greek, joins "forty years" to this verse; the Hebrew puts it with verse 10.

decisions.choice: "{{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} дело" (L)
decisions.reason: Hebrews 3:9 has "мои дела", from the Greek plural; the Hebrew has the singular "my work" (m2), which Literal keeps. Balanced uses Hebrews' plural, which says the same.

decisions.choice: "предки" (B, R) with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable say "ancestors" with no setting; Russian "предки" says the same.

decisions.choice: 'avoteikhem "あなたがたの父祖たち" (L), "あなたがたの先祖" (B, R); nissuni / bechanuni "試み" / "吟味した" (L), as HEB 3:9 L
decisions.reason: To test and try is to demand that God prove himself (m1); my work is what God had done for them (m2). The Psalter's 'avot forms; no gender span is needed (先祖 is inclusive).

source.text: אַרְבָּ֘עִ֤ים שָׁנָ֨ה׀אָ֘ק֤וּט בְּד֗וֹר וָאֹמַ֗ר עַ֤ם תֹּעֵ֣י לֵבָ֣ב הֵ֑ם וְ֝הֵ֗ם לֹא־יָדְע֥וּ דְרָכָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Forty years I loathed [that] generation, and I said, '[They are] a people going astray of heart, and they, they do not know my ways.'

en.L: Forty years I loathed [that] generation, \q and I said, '[They are] a people who go astray in heart, \q and they do not know {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} ways.'
en.B: Forty years long I was weary and disgusted with that generation. \q I said, 'These are people whose hearts wander off; \q they have never learned {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} ways.'
en.R: For forty years they disgusted {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q I said, 'Their hearts keep wandering away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q They do not know how I want them to live.'

fr.L: Quarante ans j’ai eu en dégoût [cette] génération, \q et j’ai dit : “[C’est] un peuple au cœur égaré, \q et eux, ils ne connaissent pas {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} chemins.”
fr.B: Pendant quarante ans, cette génération {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a lassé et dégoûté. \q J’ai dit : “Ce sont des gens dont le cœur s’égare ; \q ils n’ont jamais appris {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} chemins.”
fr.R: Pendant quarante ans, ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont dégoûté. \q J’ai dit : “Leur cœur s’éloigne sans cesse de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q Ils ne savent pas comment je veux qu’ils vivent.”

sw.L: Miaka arobaini nilichukizwa na kizazi [kile], \q nikasema, '[Wao ni] watu wanaopotoka mioyoni, \q nao hawazijui njia {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}.'
sw.B: Miaka arobaini nzima nilichoshwa na kuchukizwa na kizazi kile. \q Nilisema, 'Hawa ni watu ambao mioyo yao inatangatanga; \q hawajapata kamwe kujifunza njia {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}.'
sw.R: Kwa miaka arobaini walinichukiza. \q Nilisema, 'Mioyo yao inaendelea kutangatanga mbali nami. \q Hawajui jinsi ninavyotaka waishi.'

es.L: Cuarenta años aborrecí [a aquella] generación, \q y dije: ‘[Son] un pueblo que se extravía de corazón, \q y ellos no conocen {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} caminos’.
es.B: Durante cuarenta años estuve harto y disgustado con aquella generación. \q Dije: ‘Son gente cuyo corazón se desvía; \q nunca han aprendido {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} caminos’.
es.R: Durante cuarenta años {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} causaron disgusto. \q Dije: ‘Su corazón siempre se aleja de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q No saben cómo quiero que vivan’.

vi.L: Bốn mươi năm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ghê tởm thế hệ [đó], \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán: '[Đó là] một dân có lòng lầm lạc, \q và chúng không biết các đường lối của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'
vi.B: Suốt bốn mươi năm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chán ngán và ghê tởm thế hệ ấy. \q Ta đã phán: 'Đây là dân có lòng hay lạc lối; \q chúng chẳng bao giờ học biết đường lối của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'
vi.R: Suốt bốn mươi năm, chúng đã làm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ghê tởm. \q Ta đã phán: 'Lòng chúng cứ đi lạc xa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Chúng không biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} muốn chúng sống thế nào.'

ko.L: 사십 년 동안 내가 그 세대를 싫어하여 \q 말하였다. '그들은 마음이 빗나간 백성이라, \q 내 길을 알지 못한다.'
ko.B: 사십 년 동안 나는 그 세대에 지치고 넌더리가 났다. \q 내가 말했다. '이들은 마음이 엇나가는 백성이니, \q 내 길을 끝내 알지 못했다.'
ko.R: 사십 년 동안 그들이 나를 몹시 역겹게 했다. \q 내가 말했다. '그들의 마음은 자꾸 나에게서 떠나간다. \q 그들은 내가 원하는 삶을 알지 못한다.'

pt.L: Quarenta anos senti aversão por [aquela] geração, \q e disse: '[São] um povo que se desvia no coração, \q e eles não conhecem os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} caminhos.'
pt.B: Durante quarenta anos fiquei cansado e enojado daquela geração. \q Eu disse: 'O coração deles vive se desviando; \q eles nunca chegaram a conhecer os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} caminhos.'
pt.R: Durante quarenta anos eles {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} causaram nojo. \q Eu disse: 'O coração deles está sempre se desviando de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. \q Eles não sabem como eu quero que vivam.'

am.L: አርባ ዓመት ያን ትውልድ ተጸየፍኩ፤ \q እንዲህም አልኩ፦ “በልባቸው የሚስቱ ሕዝብ ናቸው፤ \q እነርሱም መንገዴን አላወቁም።”
am.B: አርባ ዓመት ሙሉ ያ ትውልድ አሰለቸኝ፤ አስጸየፈኝም። \q እንዲህም አልኩ፦ “እነዚህ ልባቸው የሚባዝን ሕዝብ ናቸው፤ \q መንገዴንም ከቶ አላወቁም።”
am.R: አርባ ዓመት ሙሉ አስጠሉኝ። \q እንዲህም አልኩ፦ “ልባቸው ሁልጊዜ ከእኔ ይባዝናል። \q እንዲኖሩ የምፈልገውን መንገድ አያውቁም።”

hi.L: चालीस वर्ष तक मैं उस पीढ़ी से घृणा करता रहा, \q और मैंने कहा, 'ये ऐसे लोग [हैं] जो मन में भटकते हैं, \q और ये मेरे मार्गों को नहीं जानते।'
hi.B: चालीस वर्ष तक मैं उस पीढ़ी से ऊबा और खिन्न रहा। \q मैंने कहा, 'इनके मन भटकते रहते हैं; \q इन्होंने कभी मेरे मार्गों को नहीं जाना।'
hi.R: चालीस वर्ष तक वे मुझे खिन्न करते रहे। \q मैंने कहा, 'इनके मन मुझसे दूर भटकते रहते हैं। \q ये नहीं जानते कि मैं इनसे कैसा जीवन चाहता हूँ।'

ru.L: Сорок лет {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} гнушался [тем] поколением \q и сказал: “[Это] народ, блуждающий сердцем, \q и они не познали {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} путей.”
ru.B: Сорок лет {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} томился и гнушался тем поколением. \q Я сказал: “Это люди, чьи сердца блуждают; \q они так и не узнали {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} путей.”
ru.R: Сорок лет они вызывали у {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} отвращение. \q Я сказал: “Их сердца всё время уходят от {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}. \q Они не знают, как {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} хочу, чтобы они жили.”

ja.L: 四十年の間、わたしはその世代をいとい、 \q そして言った。『彼らは心の迷う民であり、 \q 彼らはわたしの道を知らない。』
ja.B: 四十年もの長い間、わたしはその世代にうんざりし、嫌気がさしていた。 \q わたしは言った。『この民の心はさまよい出る。 \q 彼らは、わたしの道をついに学ばなかった。』
ja.R: 四十年の間、わたしは彼らに嫌気がさしていた。 \q わたしは言った。『彼らの心は、いつもわたしから離れてさまよう。 \q 彼らは、わたしが望む生き方を知らない。』

uk.L: Сорок років я гидував [тим] поколінням \q і сказав: “[Це] народ, що блукає серцем, \q і вони не знають {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} доріг.”
uk.B: Сорок довгих років мені було прикро й гидко від того покоління. \q Я сказав: “Це люди, чиї серця блукають; \q вони так і не пізнали {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} доріг.”
uk.R: Сорок років вони викликали в {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} огиду. \q Я сказав: “Їхні серця постійно відходять від {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}. \q Вони не знають, як я хочу, щоб вони жили.”

decisions.choice: forty years: the years in the desert
decisions.reason: After the people refused to enter the land, God said they would wander forty years until that generation had died (Numbers 14:33-34).

decisions.choice: loathed: felt disgust
decisions.reason: The verb (qut) is to feel loathing or be sick of something (119:158).

decisions.choice: know my ways: understand and follow how God acts and what he asks
decisions.reason: To know God's ways is to understand his way of acting and to walk in it (25:4; Exodus 33:13).

decisions.choice: how I want them to live
decisions.reason: Readable says what "my ways" means here (m3).

decisions.choice: "ተጸየፍኩ" (I loathed) and "ያን ትውልድ" (that generation), following the Hebrew where Hebrews 3:10 has "ተቆጣሁ" (I was angry) and "this generation"; "መንገዴን አላወቁም" kept from Hebrews
decisions.reason: The Greek of Hebrews follows the Septuagint here; where it differs from the Hebrew the Amharic follows the Hebrew, and keeps the New Testament's words where the two agree.

decisions.choice: "घृणा करता रहा" (L), "ऊबा और खिन्न रहा" (B); "मेरे मार्गों को नहीं जानते/जाना"
decisions.reason: Hebrews 3:10 follows the Greek, "I was angry with this generation". The Hebrew verb is stronger, to loathe (meaning m2), so the psalm says that; where the Hebrew says the same as Hebrews, the Hindi of Hebrews is kept ("मन ... भटकते", "मेरे मार्गों को नहीं जाना" at Balanced).

decisions.choice: "гнушался"
decisions.reason: Hebrews 3:10 has "разгневался", from the Greek; the Hebrew verb means to loathe, to feel disgust (m2). The last line keeps the wording of this translation's Hebrews ("они не познали моих путей" at L; "они так и не узнали моих путей" at B).

decisions.choice: 'aqut "いとい" (L), "うんざりし、嫌気がさしていた" (B), "嫌気がさしていた" (R); to'ei levav "心の迷う" (L); the inner quotation in 『』
decisions.reason: Forty years are the years in the desert (m1); loathed is felt disgust (m2), stronger than Hebrews' 怒り (which follows the Greek). Knowing my ways is understanding and following how God acts and what he asks (m3).

records.literal_gloss: So I swore in my anger, 'If they will enter into my rest!'

en.L: So I swore in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger, \q 'They shall not enter into {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rest!'"
en.B: So in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger I took an oath: \q 'They will never come into {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} place of rest.'"
en.R: So in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger I made a solemn vow: \q 'They will never enter the land of rest I promised them!'"

fr.L: Aussi j’ai juré dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère : \q “Ils n’entreront pas dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} repos !” »
fr.B: Alors, dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère, j’ai fait ce serment : \q “Jamais ils n’entreront dans le lieu de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} repos.” »
fr.R: Alors, dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère, j’ai fait une promesse solennelle : \q “Ils n’entreront jamais dans le pays de repos que je leur avais promis !” »

sw.L: Kwa hiyo niliapa katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, \q 'Hawataingia katika raha {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}!'"
sw.B: Basi katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} niliapa: \q 'Hawataingia kamwe mahali {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} pa raha.'"
sw.R: Kwa hiyo katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} niliweka nadhiri nzito: \q 'Hawataingia kamwe katika nchi ya raha niliyowaahidi!'"

es.L: Por eso juré en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira: \q ‘¡No entrarán en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} reposo!’».
es.B: Así que en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira hice un juramento: \q ‘Nunca entrarán en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} lugar de reposo’».
es.R: Por eso, en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enojo hice un juramento solemne: \q ‘¡Nunca entrarán en la tierra de reposo que les prometí!’».

vi.L: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thề trong cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: \q 'Chúng sẽ không được vào sự yên nghỉ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}!'"
vi.B: Vậy trong cơn giận, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thề: \q 'Chúng sẽ không bao giờ được vào nơi yên nghỉ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'"
vi.R: Vậy trong cơn giận, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã long trọng thề: \q 'Chúng sẽ không bao giờ được vào vùng đất yên nghỉ mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã hứa cho chúng!'"

ko.L: 그래서 내가 진노하여 맹세하였다. \q '그들은 결코 나의 안식에 들어오지 못할 것이다!'"
ko.B: 그래서 내가 노하여 맹세했다. \q '그들은 결코 내가 주는 안식의 땅에 들어오지 못할 것이다.'"
ko.R: 그래서 나는 노하여 엄숙하게 맹세했다. \q '그들은 내가 약속한 안식의 땅에 결코 들어가지 못할 것이다!'"

pt.L: Por isso jurei na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira: \q 'Não entrarão no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} descanso!'"
pt.B: Assim, na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira, jurei: \q 'Eles jamais entrarão no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} lugar de descanso.'"
pt.R: Por isso, na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira, fiz um juramento: \q 'Eles nunca vão entrar na terra de descanso que eu prometi a eles!'"

decisions.choice: If they enter: an oath meaning "they will never enter"
decisions.reason: In a Hebrew oath, "if" with the curse left unsaid is a strong denial: "(may I be cursed) if they enter" means they certainly will not (Numbers 14:23, 30).

decisions.choice: my rest: the land where God gives his people rest
decisions.reason: The word (menuchah) is a resting place, used of the promised land (Deuteronomy 12:9). Hebrews 4:3-11 reads it also as God's own rest, the rest of the seventh day.

decisions.choice: God's words end here
decisions.reason: The quotation that began in verse 8 closes at the end of the psalm. The psalm ends with the warning, without a return to praise.

decisions.choice: They shall not enter
decisions.reason: Even Literal says what the oath means (m1); a bare "if" would mislead.

decisions.choice: the land of rest I promised them
decisions.reason: Readable says what the rest was (m2).

decisions.choice: "በቁጣዬ … ማልኩ … ወደ ዕረፍቴ አይገቡም" (I swore in my anger … they will not enter my rest), the wording of Hebrews 3:11; 4:3, 5 in the Amharic New Testament
decisions.reason: The Hebrew agrees with the Greek here, so each level keeps the New Testament's Amharic; Readable explains "rest" as the land, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: the oath as Hebrews 3:11 and 4:3, 5
decisions.reason: Hebrews quotes the oath, and the Hebrew says the same: a strong denial (meaning m1). Literal and Balanced keep the Hindi of Hebrews ("मैंने अपने क्रोध में शपथ खाई", "वे मेरे विश्राम में ... प्रवेश न करेंगे"), Balanced adding "के स्थान" as its English adds "place of". Readable says what the rest was, the land (meaning m2), as its English does.

decisions.choice: the wording of Hebrews 3:11 and 4:3
alternatives: Они не войдут в место моего покоя
decisions.reason: The oath is quoted in Hebrews 3:11 and 4:3, 5; Literal and Balanced keep this translation's wording there ("Они не войдут в мой покой", "Они никогда не войдут в мой покой"). Readable says what the rest was, as the English does.

decisions.choice: 'im-yevo'un "入ることはない" (L), "決して…入ることはない" (B, R), as HEB 3:11; menuchati "わたしの安息" (L), "わたしの安息の地" (B), "わたしが約束した安らぎの地" (R)
decisions.reason: The oath form 'if they enter' means they will never enter (m1); my rest is the land where God gives rest (m2), which B and R make explicit. God's words close here (m3).
